name: Better Than Sex Cake

ingredients.item: chocolate cake mix (plus ingredients on box)
Heath or Skor toffee bars, crushed

instructions: Bake chocolate cake in a 9x13 pan according to package directions. Let cool 10 minutes.
Use the handle of a wooden spoon to poke holes all over the warm cake.
Pour sweetened condensed milk over the cake, letting it soak into the holes.
Drizzle caramel sauce over the entire surface.
Let cake cool completely to room temperature, then refrigerate 1 hour.
Spread whipped topping evenly over the cold cake.
Sprinkle crushed toffee bars and chocolate chips over the top.
Refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight before serving.

substitutions.dairy_free: Use dairy-free cake mix, coconut condensed milk, and dairy-free whipped topping.
substitutions.gluten_free: Use a gluten-free chocolate cake mix.

notes: Better the next day — make it the night before for the best flavor and texture.
